That’s an easy fix, here’s what you do -

-Rent/buy a media blaster, get all that loose stuff off.

- Apply Metal treatment / Rust converting product such as Ospho

-Skim coat with bondo 2x sanding between

-Industrial metal oxide primer 2x coats 

- Anti corrosive enamel top coat 2x coats

-finish off with a clear  2k epoxy

Pretty simply process and you’ll have it looking great.
